sources: Decree-Law No. 8 of 2011 on Income Tax (Al-Waqa'i' al-Filastiniyya special issue 5, 2011-10-24) arts. 12, 14, 16, as amended by Decree-Laws No. 4 of 2014 (issue 106: dividends 10 % at source, art. 16(5); bank-interest final tax art. 31(8) repealed), No. 5 of 2015 (issue 112: exemption 36,000 ILS, art. 12(1)(a); rates 5 % to 75,000, 10 % to 150,000, 15 % above, art. 16(1)) and No. 14 of 2016 (issue 123: agricultural income exempt); texts from Al-Muqtafi (Birzeit University; ids 16266, 16576, 16702, 16814) via Internet Archive captures of 2025-01 (muqtafi does not answer directly).
